list.snippet: Severe shortness of breath: Even with minimal exertion or at rest
Persistent cough: Producing thick, copious amounts of mucus
Wheezing: A whistling or squeaking sound when breathing
Chest tightness: A feeling of pressure or constriction in the chest
Frequent respiratory infections: Such as pneumonia and bronchitis
